MIT, Copyright (c) 2023 Don McCurdy

Viewer behaviour (drop a .gltf/.glb, orbit, wireframe/grid/auto-rotate,
play clips, inspect the scene, Neutral room lighting) is from that app.
Remote HDR environments (Venice Sunset, Footprint Court), the glTF
validator, Draco/KTX2/Meshopt decoder fetches from unpkg, dat.gui, and
analytics are stripped — the sandbox has no network path.

mrdoob/three.js
https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js
version: 0.176.0  (the pin in three-gltf-viewer's package.json)
file: vendor/three-viewer.js
sha256: 28b59a3964eb9d9fe337a4e378815cfbcdb5b2f4147620c9e6aa554fc4eaee5e
bytes: 757352
MIT, Copyright © 2010-2025 three.js authors

IIFE bundle of three + GLTFLoader + OrbitControls + RoomEnvironment.
Rebuilt by node apps/gltf-viewer/vendor.mjs (esbuild 0.25.9). Image and
file loaders are patched at runtime so they never fetch: textures ride
img-src data:/blob:, GLB bytes are parsed in memory.

The last model you dropped is saved on this device. Press Invite to look
at it together; guests drop their own file. Upstream is a public page
that never kept the file.
